Casey: quick FYIfound dup emails in sampleapp when token rotated + 429. repro attached.

Jordan: short trace please?

Casey: original POST /v1/send_email (token A) -> auth refresh to B mid-flight -> upstream returns 429 -> SDK retries with token B but no Idempotency-Key on retried envelope. server accepted both.

Lee: sounds like node mutates header map and retry path reuses it. python composes at send-time so it's fine.

Jordan: fix plan: always compose fresh headers at retry-time or clone computed headers into new envelope. also add full jitter for backoff: uniform(0, base * 2^attempt).

Casey: adding tiny CI harness in sampleapp that simulates rotation + injected 429s to assert no duplicate side-effects.

Lee: also prototyping a short-lived resume token header `X-Redwood-Resume` on 429 to let server dedupe optional retries. security: bind token to account and short TTL.

infra-bot: CI queued for redwood/sampleapp#190 unit tests running.

Jordan: assigning node SDK change to me: regen headers on retry + optional idempotency auto flag. will add unit tests.

Casey: thanks all, filing DX card for parity docs.
